Overview

Bielefeld is a city in North Rhine-Westphalia with a population of 334,000. A green city in the Teutoburg Forest, known for its university, thriving food industry, and the famous Bielefeld conspiracy meme. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
